name: AI Deep Dive — PSIX — 2026-05-02
rationale: Power Solutions International (PSIX) is a highly profitable, under-the-radar beneficiary of the AI data center power constraint. Producing $722M in revenue with 32% growth and stellar 15.7% net margins, it trades at an attractive 14x P/E multiple. The company provides prime and standby power generation, perfectly positioning it to capture demand where grid power falls short. Weighted PV of $112.87 implies significant upside.

aiThesis.rationale: PSIX is a compelling 'picks and shovels' play on the AI power bottleneck. Unlike highly speculative, capital-burning peers, PSIX is already highly profitable (15.7% net margins) and growing robustly (32.5% YoY) with a solid Piotroski F-Score of 6. At just 14x trailing earnings, the market is mispricing this as a cyclical industrial manufacturer rather than critical infrastructure. As data centers increasingly rely on on-site prime and standby power generation to bypass grid delays, PSIX is perfectly positioned. The base case ($112.80 PV) models 15% growth and stable margins, making the current $70.50 price a deep value entry point.
